definitions.explanation: Having the shape of a rod or stick. Used as a noun or with の to modify another noun.

examples.japanese: {棒状|ぼうじょう}の{金属|きんぞく}を{曲|ま}げる。
examples.english: To bend a rod-shaped piece of metal.

examples.japanese: {野菜|やさい}を{棒状|ぼうじょう}に{切|き}ってスティックサラダにした。
examples.english: I cut the vegetables into stick shapes and made a stick salad.

notes:
A descriptive compound of {棒|ぼう} (rod; stick) and {状|じょう} (shape; form). The suffix {状|じょう} is productive and attaches to many nouns to mean "in the shape of" or "in the form of."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {棒状|ぼうじょう}に{切|き}る: to cut into stick shapes
- {棒状|ぼうじょう}の{物体|ぶったい}: a rod-shaped object
- {棒状|ぼうじょう}に{伸|の}ばす: to stretch into a rod shape

RELATED SHAPE WORDS:
- {球状|きゅうじょう}: spherical
- {板状|ばんじょう}: plate-shaped; flat
- {筒状|つつじょう}: cylindrical; tube-shaped
- {粒状|りゅうじょう}: granular; grain-shaped
